newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR SWITZERLAND V HUNGARY WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR SWITZERLAND V HUNGARY WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: ZURICH, April 30 (REUTER) - Teams for the World Cup group three qualifier between Switzerland and Hungary on Wednesday: Switzerland: 1-Stephan Lehmann, 2-Christophe Ohrel, 3-Marco Walker, 4-Ramon Vega, 5-Raphael Wicky, 6-Murat Yakin, 7-Adrian Kunz, 8-Johann Vogel, 9-Kubilay Turkyilmaz, 10-Ciriaco Sforza, 11-Stephane Chapuisat. Substitutes 12-Pascal Zuberbuehler, 13-Regis Rothenbuehler, 14-Stefan Wolf, 15-David Sesa, 16-Massimo Lombardo, 17-Frederic Chassot, 18-Marco Grassi Hungary: 1-Szabolcs Safar, 2-Attila Kuttor, 3-Janos Banfi, 4-Norbert Nagy, 5-Emil Lorine, 6-Andras Kereszturi, 7-Mihaly Mracsko, 8-Florian Urban, 9-Ferenc Orosz, 10-Bela Illes, 11- Laszlo Klausz. Substitutes 12-Ferenc Horvath, 13-Gor Halmai, 14- Elek Nyilas, 15-Tibor Balog, 16- Gabor Babos, 17-Zoltan Szelezak, 18-Laszlo Farkashazy Referee: Leif Sundell (Sweden)
